name: Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar is a time management tool providing scheduling features, event reminders, and integration with email and other apps for streamlined organization

tools.name: Delete ACL Rule

inputs.name: rule_id
inputs.about: ACL rule identifier. Format: 'scope_type:scope_value' or 'default'. Valid scope types: 'user' (email), 'group' (group email), 'domain' (domain name), 'default' (public access). Examples: 'user:john@example.com', 'group:team@example.com', 'domain:example.com', 'default'. Note: 'me' is NOT valid; use

tools.name: Create ACL Rule
tools.description: Creates an access control rule for a calendar. Use when you need to grant sharing permissions to a user, group, or domain.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values: "none" - Provides no access; "freeBusyReader" - Provides read access to free/busy information; "reader" - Provides read access to the calendar; "writer" - Provides read and write access to the calendar; "owner" - Provides ownership of the calendar.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule. Specifies who gets the access (user, group, domain, or default).

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

inputs.name: send_notifications
inputs.about: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Optional. The default is true.

tools.name: List ACL Rules
tools.description: Retrieves the list of access control rules (ACLs) for a specified calendar, providing the necessary 'rule_id' values required for updating specific ACL rules.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.about: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional.

inputs.name: syncToken
inputs.about: Token obtained from the nextSyncToken field returned on the last page of a previous list operation. It makes the result of this list operation contain only entries that have changed since then. Optional. The default is to retrieve all entries.

inputs.name: calendarId
inputs.about: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.about: Maximum number of entries returned on one result page. Optional. The default is 100.

inputs.name: showDeleted
inputs.about: Whether to include deleted ACLs in the result. Optional. The default is False.

inputs.name: scope

inputs.about: ACL rule identifier of an existing rule. IMPORTANT: The rule must already exist on the calendar - this action cannot create new rules, only modify existing ones. inputs.name: send_notifications

tools.name: Watch ACL Changes

inputs.name: calendarId

tools.name: Batch Events
tools.description: Execute up to 1000 event mutations (create/patch/delete) in one Google Calendar HTTP batch request with per-item status/results. Use this to materially reduce round-trips for bulk operations like migrations, cleanup, or large-scale updates.

inputs.name: fail_fast
inputs.about: If true, stop processing after the first batch containing any 4xx error (except 404 on DELETE). Default is false.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.about: List of batch operations to execute. Maximum 1000 operations per request.

inputs.about: The identifier of the calendar to insert. Must be a valid calendar ID in email format (e.g., ‘user@example.com’ for a user’s calendar or ‘calendarid@group.calendar.google.com’ for a shared calendar). inputs.name: colorId

tools.name: Delete Calendar
tools.description: Deletes a secondary calendar that you own or have delete permissions on. Deletion is permanent and irreversible — verify the correct calendar_id before calling. You cannot delete your primary calendar or calendars you only have read/write access to. Use calendarList.list to find calendars with owner accessRole. For primary calendars, use calendars.clear instead. Parallel calls may trigger userRateLimitExceeded; sequence bulk deletions.

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Calendar identifier for a secondary calendar you own or have delete permissions on. Use calendarList.list to find deletable calendar IDs (look for accessRole "owner"). Primary calendars cannot be deleted; use the Clear Calendar action instead.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Full PUT-style update that overwrites all calendar metadata fields; unspecified optional fields are cleared. Use GOOGLECALENDAR_PATCH_CALENDAR to update only a subset of fields. Mutates the underlying calendar resource (title, description, timeZone, etc.); use GOOGLECALENDAR_CALENDAR_LIST_UPDATE to change per-user display properties like color.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: Title of the calendar. Must be a non-empty string; passing an empty string clears the calendar title.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Optional.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.about: The time zone of the calendar. (Formatted as an IANA Time Zone Database name, e.g. "Europe/Zurich".) Optional.

inputs.name: calendarId
inputs.about: Calendar identifier. Use 'primary' to update the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, or provide a specific calendar ID (typically in email format like 'abc123@group.calendar.google.com'). To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. IMPORTANT: This is NOT the calendar's

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the calendar. Optional.

inputs.name: id

inputs.name: token

tools.name: Clear Calendar
tools.description: Clears a primary calendar by deleting all events from it. The calendar itself is preserved; only its events are removed. Primary calendars cannot be deleted entirely.

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Primary calendar to clear: "`primary`" or the account's own email address. Google only clears primary calendars; secondary calendar IDs return 400 Invalid Value. To remove a secondary calendar's events, delete them individually or delete the calendar.

tools.name: Get Color Definitions
tools.description: Returns the color definitions for calendars and events. Use when you need to retrieve the available color palette for styling calendars or events.

tools.name: Create a new calendar
tools.description: Creates a new secondary Google Calendar with the specified title and optional settings. Use this action when you need to create a new calendar for organizing events separately from the primary calendar. The authenticated user becomes the owner of the newly created calendar. Optional parameters include description, location, and timezone.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: Title of the calendar. This is the name that will be displayed in Google Calendar.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.about: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). If not specified, defaults to UTC.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the calendar. Provides additional context about the calendar's purpose.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes an event from the specified calendar. Only Google's HTTP 204 confirms deletion; 404 or 410 can also mean the event belongs to a different calendar. Bulk deletions may trigger `rateLimitExceeded` or `userRateLimitExceeded`; cap concurrency to 5–10 requests and apply exponential backoff.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the event to delete. For standalone events, use the base event ID (e.g., 'abc123def456'). For recurring event instances, use the instance ID format 'baseEventId_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ' (e.g., 'abc123def456_20260522T093000Z') where the timestamp suffix represents the instance's origina

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Calendar (e.g., email address, specific ID, or 'primary' for the authenticated user's main calendar) from which the event will be deleted. Calendars without event-deletion permission, including subscribed calendars not owned by the authenticated user, return 403 on deletion

inputs.name: send_updates
inputs.about: Options for who should receive notifications about event changes.

inputs.name: send_notifications
inputs.about: Deprecated. Whether to send notifications about the deletion of the event. Note that some emails might still be sent.

tools.name: Create a calendar
tools.description: Creates a new, empty Google Calendar with the specified title (summary). Newly created calendars default to UTC timezone; use GOOGLECALENDAR_PATCH_CALENDAR afterward to set the desired timeZone if needed.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: Title for the new Google Calendar to be created. Required and must be a non-empty string.

tools.name: Get Event
tools.description: Retrieves a SINGLE event by its unique event_id (REQUIRED). This action does NOT list or search events - it fetches ONE specific event when you already know its ID. If you want to list events within a time range, search for events, or filter by criteria like time_min/time_max, use GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST instead.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.about: REQUIRED. The unique identifier of the specific event to retrieve. You must already know this ID (e.g., from a previous EVENTS_LIST call or event creation response). This action fetches ONE event by ID - it cannot list or search events. To find events by time range or search criteria, use GOOGLECALE

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.about: Time zone used in the response. If not specified, the calendar's time zone is used.

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Calendar (e.g., email address, specific ID, or 'primary' for the authenticated user's main calendar) from which to retrieve the event.

inputs.name: max_attendees
inputs.about: Maximum number of attendees to include in the response. If there are more than the specified number, only the participant is returned.

tools.name: Import Event
tools.description: Tool to import an event as a private copy to a calendar. Use when you need to add an existing event to a calendar using its iCalUID. Only events with eventType='default' can be imported.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: The (exclusive) end time of the event. For all-day events, use 'date' field; for timed events, use 'dateTime' and 'timeZone' fields.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: The (inclusive) start time of the event. For all-day events, use 'date' field; for timed events, use 'dateTime' and 'timeZone' fields. `dateTime` must be ISO 8601 format (e.g., `'2024-01-15T10:00:00'`); `timeZone` should match the calendar's timezone to avoid shifted times.

inputs.name: source
inputs.about: Source from which the event was created.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Status of the event. Possible values: 'confirmed', 'tentative', 'cancelled'.

inputs.name: colorId
inputs.about: The color of the event. This is an ID referring to an entry in the event colors definition.

inputs.name: iCalUID
inputs.about: Event unique identifier as defined in RFC5545. This is required to identify the event being imported.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: Title of the event.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.about: Sequence number as per iCalendar.

inputs.name: attendees
inputs.about: The attendees of the event.

inputs.name: reminders
inputs.about: Information about the event's reminders for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: recurrence
inputs.about: List of RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE and EXDATE lines for a recurring event, as specified in RFC5545. Each string must include the full prefix (e.g., `'RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO'`); omitting the prefix causes a 400 error.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Visibility of the event. Possible values: 'default', 'public', 'private', 'confidential'. Default: 'default'.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.about: File attachments for the event.

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Calendar identifier. Use 'primary' for the logged-in user's primary calendar or the calendar's email address.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the event. Can contain HTML.

inputs.name: transparency
inputs.about: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar. Possible values: 'opaque' (blocks time), 'transparent' (does not block time). Default: 'opaque'.

inputs.name: guestsCanModify
inputs.about: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event. Default: False.

inputs.name: extendedProperties
inputs.about: Extended properties of the event.

inputs.name: supportsAttachments
inputs.about: Whether API client performing operation supports event attachments. Default: False.

inputs.name: conferenceDataVersion
inputs.about: Version number of conference data supported by the API client. Version 0 assumes no conference data support and ignores conference data in the event's body. Version 1 enables copying of ConferenceData as well as for creating new conferences using the createRequest field of conferenceData. Default: 0

inputs.name: guestsCanInviteOthers
inputs.about: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others to the event. Default: True.

inputs.name: guestsCanSeeOtherGuests
inputs.about: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are. Default: True.

tools.name: Get Event Instances
tools.description: Returns instances of the specified recurring event. Use timeMin/timeMax to constrain the window; omitting bounds can return large result sets and is quota-heavy. On high-volume calls, 403 rateLimitExceeded or 429 too_many_requests may occur; apply exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) before retrying.

inputs.name: eventId
inputs.about: REQUIRED. The ID of the recurring event whose instances you want to retrieve. You must first use GOOGLECALENDAR_FIND_EVENT or GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST to find recurring events and get their IDs. This action only works with recurring events that have a recurrence rule.

inputs.name: timeMax
inputs.about: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time to filter by. Optional. The default is not to filter by start time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.

inputs.name: timeMin
inputs.about: Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time to filter by. Optional. The default is not to filter by end time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.about: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is the time zone of the calendar.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.about: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional.

inputs.name: calendarId
inputs.about: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the `calendarList.list` method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.about: Maximum number of events returned on one result page. By default the value is 250 events. The page size can never be larger than 2500 events. Optional.

inputs.name: showDeleted
inputs.about: Whether to include deleted events (with status equals "cancelled") in the result. Cancelled instances of recurring events will still be included if `singleEvents` is False. Optional. The default is False.

inputs.name: maxAttendees

tools.name: Remove attendee from event
tools.description: Removes an attendee from a specified event in a Google Calendar; the calendar and event must exist. Concurrent calls on the same event can overwrite attendee lists — apply changes sequentially per event.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the event. For recurring events, target the master series ID or a specific instance ID; removing an attendee from one instance does not affect other instances in the series.

inputs.name: calendar_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Calendar to which the event belongs; 'primary' signifies the user's main calendar.

inputs.name: attendee_email
inputs.about: Email address of the attendee to remove. Must match an attendee email present on the event. If no match is found, the attendee was already removed or was never on the event.

tools.name: Get Calendar Setting

inputs.name: setting

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.about: Token specifying which result page to return.

inputs.name: syncToken
inputs.about: Token obtained from the nextSyncToken field returned on the last page of results from the previous list request. inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.about: Maximum number of entries returned on one result page. By default the value is 100 entries. The page size can never be larger than 250 entries.

tools.name: Watch Settings
tools.description: Watch for changes to Settings resources.

inputs.name: id

inputs.about: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel. Must be "web_hook".

inputs.name: token

inputs.about: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The address where notifications are delivered for this channel.

inputs.name: expiration
inputs.about: Unix timestamp in milliseconds specifying when the API should stop sending notifications for this channel.

tools.name: Sync Events (Deprecated)

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Token for paginating results, from a previous response's `nextPageToken`. Repeat with each returned `nextPageToken` until no `nextPageToken` is returned; stopping early silently omits remaining events.

inputs.name: sync_token
inputs.about: Token for incremental sync, retrieving only changes since issued. A 410 GONE response indicates an expired token, requiring a full sync. Cannot be combined with `timeMin`, `timeMax`, `orderBy`, `query`, or `updatedMin`; mixing these causes the request to fail.

inputs.name: calendar_id

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.about: Max events per page (max 2500); Google Calendar's default is used if unspecified.

inputs.name: single_events
inputs.about: If True, expands recurring events into individual instances (excluding master event); otherwise, Google's default handling applies.
